title: Samsung Z Fold 8 Future Promotion
body:
Hey everyone!
Unfortunately, I missed the pre-order deal like many others 😭 Been keeping an eye on the Fold 8 prices for a while now, but there haven’t really been any good deals so far. Maybe because it’s selling so well?
Really hoping there’ll be some decent discounts for Black Friday.
Anyone reckon the prices will drop much? Or know of any good deals I might have missed?
Any tips would be much appreciated! 😊
